applied.name: gamma-valerolactone
applied.value: Review-table leg of the gamma-valerolactone dual row (W17-1). The beta lactone value 36.1 (iScience 2026 Table 3) is kept verbatim, but a competing primary supporting-information measurement 36.9 (Segato et al. 2021, Inorg. Chim. Acta 522, 120372) is registered as its own row. Under the source-quality rule the primary leg is the main value; neither leg carries a temperature, so the pair is flagged unresolved and both remain model_ready=false. The v0.3 model_ready=true on this row was written before the competing primary leg was known; the field is protected and is therefore not silently rewritten in v0.4 -- the inconsistency is registered for a future v0.5 decision instead.
applied.rationale: W17-1: record the conflict on the review-table leg without touching any protected field.
